title.it: Mandati di arresto CPI nel caso Netanyahu/Gallant
title.en: ICC arrest warrants in the Netanyahu/Gallant case

description.it: La Corte penale internazionale emette mandati contro esponenti israeliani; seguiranno sanzioni USA contro la Corte.
description.en: The International Criminal Court issues warrants against Israeli officials; US sanctions against the Court will follow.

note.it: Mandati della CPI classificati «Spyware / diritti»: riclassificare come giustizia internazionale/diplomazia.
note.en: ICC warrants classified as «Spyware / rights»: reclassify as international justice/diplomacy.

notes: Themes follow the reclassification reported in S07 §11 / S08 §20.2, not the original category.
